purge.rules: Your turn only. Play as one Group's action. Illuminati: destroy every Agent in play that duplicates your Illuminati. Any other Group loses 1 Power and 1 Global Power, but rival duplicates no longer affect it; link this card to it.
purge.flavor: The loyalty review found three moles and one confused intern. All were reassigned to oblivion.

rain-of-frogs.rules: Disaster. No action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any Place of any size at Power 10, plus 4 for each Frog God its owner has in play. Success Devastates it; success by 7+ destroys it outright.
rain-of-frogs.flavor: Forecast: scattered amphibians, heavy at times. Some arriving in formation.

reach-out.rules: Your turn only. At the end of your turn, spend your Illuminati's action. Remove every Action token from one rival's Power Structure, then from your own. Resources keep their tokens.
reach-out.flavor: A friendly call to check on their plans. By the time they hung up, they had forgotten them.

read-my-lips.rules: Counter. Play after an Attack to Control or Attack to Destroy against one of your Personalities succeeds. That attack fails instead. Useless against Assassinations.
read-my-lips.flavor: The promise was firm, sincere and televised. The reversal was scheduled for a slow news day.

red-scare.rules: Any time. Spend your Illuminati's action to give an Action token to your tokenless Conservative Groups: any one, or several with total Power 5 or less. Not Groups captured this turn or barred from receiving tokens.
red-scare.flavor: Under every bed, a subversive. Under every subversive, a funding opportunity for the vigilant.

reload.rules: Any time. Spend your Illuminati's action to give an Action token to your tokenless Violent Groups: any one, or several with total Power 5 or less. Not Groups captured this turn or barred from receiving tokens.
reload.flavor: Diplomacy failed at breakfast. By lunch, the negotiators had requested more ammunition.

reorganization.rules: Your turn only. Spend your Illuminati's action to rearrange your whole Power Structure as you like, moving your Groups to any legal positions.
reorganization.flavor: The new org chart is bold, agile and synergistic. Nobody knows who reports to whom, by design.

resistance-is-useless.rules: Any time. One of your Media Groups spends its action. Until end of turn, the target Group has Resistance 0, with no bonus from abilities or its master's alignments. Its +5/+10 for closeness to its Illuminati still applies.
resistance-is-useless.flavor: After three weeks of coverage, the board simply agreed it had always wanted to be acquired.

revolution.rules: During an attack. Play with any Attack to Control or Destroy on a Nation: +10, or +20 if it is a Dictatorship. A Group not taking part in the attack must spend its action.
revolution.flavor: The palace fell by noon. The new regime held a press conference by two, a parade by four.

rewriting-history.rules: Any time. Add, remove or reverse one alignment of a destroyed Group; this can change which destruction Goals it counts toward. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Media Groups' actions totalling Power 8+.
rewriting-history.flavor: The archives have been updated for accuracy. The previous accuracy has been filed somewhere unreachable.

sabotage.rules: Counter. A rival's automatic takeover from hand fails: the Group returns to their hand and they get no more automatic takeovers this turn. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Groups totalling Power 6+, one sharing an alignment with it.
sabotage.flavor: The keys were cut and the office furnished. Then someone swapped the address on the deed.

save-the-whales.rules: Any time. A Green Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
save-the-whales.flavor: The whales were saved. So was the donor list, which was cross-referenced and quietly sold.

savings-loan-scam.rules: Any time. Spend any one of your Groups' actions. Discard this card and draw 3 cards from your Plot deck.
savings-loan-scam.flavor: Deposits were insured, loans were imaginary and the auditors were on a fact-finding cruise.

scandal.rules: Any time, but not during an attack. Spend the action of a Media Group with Power 2+. Choose a rival and one alignment that Media Group has: that rival's Groups with that alignment lose all Action tokens.
scandal.flavor: Sources close to the source confirm that sources have been confirmed. Resignations to follow.

secrets-man-was-not-meant-to-know.rules: Counter. Play right after any other Plot is played, for any purpose: cancel it and discard both cards. Pay by removing every Action token from your Illuminati (at least 1), or by discarding your top 2 Plot deck cards unseen.
secrets-man-was-not-meant-to-know.flavor: The manuscript explained everything. Its last reader now alphabetises his socks by feel.

seize-the-time.rules: At the start of a rival's turn, spend your Illuminati's action to take a special turn instead; then theirs resumes unless someone won. Only your Groups get Action tokens. No drawing, no Plots. Not in round 1; once per game.
seize-the-time.flavor: History waits for no one. You simply arranged for it to wait for everyone else.

self-esteem.rules: Any time. Use the action of one of your Liberal Groups to link this card to it. Its Power rises to 6 at once; a stronger Group keeps its Power. You may have only 1 Self Esteem in play.
self-esteem.flavor: After the weekend retreat, the committee stopped apologising and annexed the building next door.

senate-investigating-committee.rules: As another player's turn begins, spend a Power 5+ Government Group's action. That turn they may only draw cards and place Action tokens. Not against the Discordians. Once per game per target; a repeat fizzles and is discarded.
senate-investigating-committee.flavor: The hearings will continue until the witness remembers something or the cameras leave.

slush-fund.rules: Any time. A Conservative Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
slush-fund.flavor: No receipts, no ledger, no questions. Just a very large envelope and a handshake that lingers.

sniper.rules: Assassination. Any time, no action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any Personality at Power 10. One Government Group of yours may spend its action to join and add its Power.
sniper.flavor: Officially the rooftop was empty and the rifle was a telescope. No further comment.

spasm-of-violence.rules: During an attack. Play with one of your Assassinations plus a second Assassination card against the same target. Follow the main one's full text; the second adds only its Power, none of its other effects.
spasm-of-violence.flavor: One attempt is a tragedy. Two at once is a coordination problem someone gets promoted for.

stealing-the-plans.rules: Counter. Right after another player discards a Plot, used or unused, take it into your hand. Costs the action of one of your Groups with Power 3+.
stealing-the-plans.flavor: They spent months drafting the scheme. You spent five minutes with a photocopier and a borrowed badge.

stock-split.rules: Any time. A Corporate Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
stock-split.flavor: Shareholders now own twice as many shares of exactly the same thing. They were thrilled.

straighten-up.rules: Any time. Target Group becomes Straight for good, losing Weird; link this card. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Straight Groups' actions totalling at least its Resistance (x2 if Weird), plus closeness bonus if a rival's.
straighten-up.flavor: Three sessions of posture coaching and a sensible briefcase. The subject no longer recalls being interesting.

sucked-dry-and-cast-aside.rules: During an attack. When one of your Groups (not your Illuminati) attacks, aids or opposes, its Power is multiplied by 4 for that action. Afterward it is destroyed, but counts toward no one's Goals.
sucked-dry-and-cast-aside.flavor: The consultants extracted every last ounce of value, then billed the husk for their time.

sweeping-reforms.rules: Any time. Discard every New World Order in play. Pay with actions of Media Groups totalling Power 6+; other players' Media Groups may chip in if their owners agree.
sweeping-reforms.flavor: The old order is swept away, replaced by a new one with more committees and better branding.

sweepstakes-prize.rules: Any time. Link this to one of your Personalities. It gets +4 on every direct Attack to Control it makes. You may have only 1 Sweepstakes Prize in play.
sweepstakes-prize.flavor: You may already be a winner. You are definitely already on a list.

swiss-bank-account.rules: During an attack. When your Illuminati makes a direct attack, it gets +10 Power for that attack. Never applies to Global Power.
swiss-bank-account.flavor: Numbered, discreet and wonderfully forgetful, especially whenever the tax inspector calls.

talisman-of-ahrimanes.rules: Counter. After an Assassination is played, it fails automatically. Link this to the saved Personality: it gets +2 against later Attacks to Destroy, +10 against Assassinations. If it dies anyway, the Talisman goes too. Only 1 in play.
talisman-of-ahrimanes.flavor: Carved by a forgotten cult, rediscovered in a pawn shop between a saxophone and a bowling trophy.

tax-breaks.rules: Any time. Spend your Illuminati's action to give an Action token to your tokenless Corporate Groups: any one, or several with total Power 5 or less. Not Groups captured this turn or barred from receiving tokens.
tax-breaks.flavor: The loophole was drafted by the companies it benefits and praised by the lawmakers they fund.

terrorist-nuke.rules: Any time. A Violent Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
terrorist-nuke.flavor: The device was small, crude and possibly fake. The uncertainty was worth more than the uranium.

the-auditor-from-hell.rules: Any time. Spend the action of the Network, a Computer Group or a Bank Group. Look at all of one rival's hidden Plots, then take one of them or expose them all.
the-auditor-from-hell.flavor: Every receipt since kindergarten. Every coffee. Every napkin. The auditor was thorough, and personally delighted.

the-big-score.rules: Any time. A Criminal Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
the-big-score.flavor: One last job. It's always one last job. The pension plan here is remarkably flexible.

the-big-sellout.rules: Your turn only. Right after placing Action tokens, discard up to 10 Groups and Resources from your hand and the top of your Group deck. Each Group discarded gives 1 extra Action token to a different Group you control.
the-big-sellout.flavor: Everything must go: principles, allies, old friends. No refunds. Fire sale ends at dawn.

the-first-thing-we-do-let-s-kill-all-the.rules: During an attack. +20 to any Attack to Destroy the Lawyers. Whoever plays this must read a mock legal disclaimer aloud; it has no game effect.
the-first-thing-we-do-let-s-kill-all-the.flavor: Counsel advises that this card is purely hypothetical. Counsel has stopped returning calls.

the-internet-worm.rules: Any time. Choose a rival: the top 3 cards of their Plot deck are discarded unseen. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Computer Groups' actions totalling Power 3+.
the-internet-worm.flavor: It began as a harmless experiment. By Tuesday every server on Earth subscribed to its newsletter.

the-oregon-crud.rules: Disaster. Any time, no action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any non-Huge Place at Power 24. Success Devastates it; success by 10 or more destroys it outright.
the-oregon-crud.flavor: Scientists call it a fungal bloom. Residents stopped calling it anything after dark.

the-second-bullet.rules: During an attack. Right after your own Attack to Destroy fails its roll, your Groups that could have aided it and still hold Action tokens may spend them, adding their Power as needed to make it a success.
the-second-bullet.flavor: The inquiry ruled the first shot missed and the second a coincidence. The third was never discussed.

the-stars-are-right.rules: Your turn only. Spend your Illuminati's action, or actions of Magic Groups each with Power 4+, to put a Resource from your hand into play as an automatic takeover, with no roll.
the-stars-are-right.flavor: The alignment comes once in a hundred millennia. Luckily it fell on a quiet Thursday.

the-weak-link.rules: Any time, except during a Privileged attack. Destroy a rival's Artifact or Gadget Resource and discard it. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Science, Magic or Computer Groups' actions totalling Power 6+.
the-weak-link.flavor: Every perfect machine has one bolt fitted by the cheapest subcontractor. You found him.

the-weird-turn-pro.rules: Any time. Use the action of one of your Weird Groups to link this card to it. Its Power rises to 4 at once; a stronger Group keeps its Power. Limit 1 in play per player.
the-weird-turn-pro.flavor: The support group became a startup. The startup became a movement. The movement now sells merch.

tidal-wave.rules: Disaster. No action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy a Coastal Place at Power 20 if it is Huge, 24 otherwise. Success Devastates it; success by 11+ destroys it outright.
tidal-wave.flavor: The resort promised ocean views from every room. The ocean took that literally.

time-warp.rules: Counter. Right after another player rolls a success, they must reroll and keep the new result, but they also draw a Group card.
time-warp.flavor: Déjà vu is the universe checking its work. Today it found an error in your favour.

tornado.rules: Disaster. No action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy a non-Huge Place at Power 12. Success Devastates it; success by 5+ destroys it outright.
tornado.flavor: Forecast: light winds. The station's weather van was later found two counties over.

unlucky-13.rules: At the very start of a rival's turn, spend the action of one of your Magic Groups. Until that turn ends, the rival cannot draw Plot cards for any reason.
unlucky-13.flavor: The elevator skipped a floor, the calendar skipped a day, and their luck skipped town.

unmasked.rules: Any time, not during an attack. Play with an Illuminati card from your hand: it replaces your Illuminati, with its own powers and Goal; discard the old one. Any Agents card you hold for the new Illuminati is lost.
unmasked.flavor: Behind the mask was another mask, and behind that a very long list of demands.

upheaval.rules: Any time, but not during an attack or on your first turn. Spend your Illuminati's action: every player, you included, discards one Group from their Power Structure. Discarded, not destroyed, so none counts toward victory.
upheaval.flavor: Everyone agreed something had to go. Everyone agreed it should be someone else's something.

volcano.rules: Disaster. No action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy a non-Huge Place at Power 18. Success Devastates it; success by 2+ destroys it outright.
volcano.flavor: The brochure called the mountain dormant. It was merely procrastinating.

volunteer-aid.rules: During an attack. When a Disaster strikes a Place, it gets +6 to defend. If it is still Devastated, it gets Relief automatically at the start of its owner's next turn. Costs no action.
volunteer-aid.flavor: The volunteers arrived with blankets, soup and a startling amount of branded merchandise.

voodoo-economics.rules: Your turn only. Right after placing Action tokens, spend your Illuminati's action to remove up to 10 top Plot deck cards from the game. Each gives 1 extra Action token to a different Group of yours. Once per game.
voodoo-economics.flavor: Wealth will trickle down any day now. The chart says so, read by candlelight.

vultures.rules: Counter. When a rival discards a Group they failed to take over from their hand, take that Group card from their discard pile into your hand.
vultures.flavor: They circle the halls of power, patient and well-fed, waiting for someone's ambitions to expire.

whispering-campaign.rules: During an attack. Spend one of your Media Groups' action: your Attack to Destroy gets +15 against a Personality, +10 against any other Group. Not with Assassinations or Disasters. A Personality destroyed this way can never return to play.
whispering-campaign.flavor: Nobody said anything, exactly. An eyebrow was raised at exactly the right dinner party.

withering-curse.rules: Assassination. Any time, no action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any Personality at Power 10. One Magic Group of yours may spend its action to add its Power. The attack counts as Magic.
withering-curse.flavor: He felt fine at breakfast. By dinner, his portrait looked healthier than he did.

world-cup-victory.rules: Any time. A Nation Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
world-cup-victory.flavor: The team won on penalties. The ruling party awarded itself a medal and a tax holiday.

angel-s-feather.rules: Link to a Peaceful Group. If that Group fails an Attack to Control, reroll it. If any attack on a Peaceful Group you control succeeds, reroll it. The reroll stands.
angel-s-feather.flavor: Lot 44: one feather, provenance celestial, recovered from a windowsill. Handle only with gloves.

ark-of-the-covenant.rules: On your turn, secretly note one of your Groups under this card. If it is destroyed, reveal it: its destroyer is destroyed too (an Illuminati's owner loses a Group of their choice instead), counting for your Goals. Then note another.
ark-of-the-covenant.flavor: Crate 9 of 9. Do not open. Do not touch. Do not ask about Gerald.

bigfoot.rules: Bigfoot has its own action: spend it to cancel an action taken by a Media Group. You also get +3 on every attempt to control a Green Group.
bigfoot.flavor: Exhibit 7: one plaster footprint, size 23, and an unsigned modelling release.

book-of-kells.rules: Choose one. Unlinked: your Illuminati gets +1 Power and +1 Global Power. Linked to a Magic Group: that Group may take 2 actions per turn, but neither may be an Attack to Destroy.
book-of-kells.flavor: Illuminated manuscript, gold leaf throughout. The marginal doodles appear to be troop movements.

center-for-weird-studies.rules: Once in each of your turns, discard a Plot to give a new Action token to one of your Groups or Resources that has already acted. A Group still can't add its Power to one attack twice.
center-for-weird-studies.flavor: Campus facility, founding date disputed. Departments: psychic houseplants, spontaneous combustion, unmarked vans.

clipper-chip.rules: Every Government Group in your Power Structure gets +2 Power, and you are wholly immune to the Phone Phreaks. If you ever control no Government Group, discard this. Limit 1 per player.
clipper-chip.flavor: Standard-issue listening device. Listens only to criminals, defined as whoever it is listening to.

crystal-skull.rules: Each time you draw a Plot, look at the top 3 cards of your Plot deck and keep the one you want. Put each of the others on the top or bottom of the deck before your next draw.
crystal-skull.flavor: Carved quartz, origin disputed. Gazes into the future with an air of mild disappointment.

cyborg-soldiers.rules: Link to a Violent Group: its Power is doubled. The Soldiers are lost along with that Group.
cyborg-soldiers.flavor: Half man, half machine, fully covered by an extended warranty nobody has ever claimed.

death-mask.rules: Link to a Magic Group. Once the dice have been rolled, it may spend its action to join the attack, provided it was eligible to join normally. If its Power changes the outcome, the new result applies.
death-mask.flavor: Plaster cast of a sorcerer who died laughing. Chuckles softly whenever somebody rolls badly.

earthquake-projector.rules: Has its own action, usable once per turn: add +2 to any Attack to Destroy a Place, or to any Disaster.
earthquake-projector.flavor: Patent pending. Liability pending. Tested once, on the building that housed the patent office.

eliza.rules: Link to the Network or a Computer Group: it gets 1 extra action per turn. If that extra action ever rolls 11 or 12, Eliza crashes: discard her and reveal all your hidden Plots. Limit 1 per Group.
eliza.flavor: Therapy software, version 1.0. Asks how that makes you feel, then forwards the answer.

flying-saucer.rules: Linked to a Personality: it gets +10 against Attacks to Destroy, Assassinations included, and the Saucer is captured or destroyed with it. Unlinked: once per turn, discard your top Plot deck card for an extra automatic Resource takeover.
flying-saucer.flavor: Recovered craft, one careful owner, low mileage. Tractor beam sold separately.

hallucinations.rules: Has its own action, usable once per turn: either cancel the action of any Personality, or add +3 to any attempt to destroy a Personality.
hallucinations.flavor: Evidence bag 12: one sugar cube, unlabelled. The cabinet meeting it attended is still under review.

hammer-of-thor.rules: Has its own action, usable once per turn: give +2 Power to any Government or Violent Group when it makes an attack, or when it defends against an Attack to Destroy.
hammer-of-thor.flavor: Only the worthy can lift it. The worthy turn out to be mostly defence contractors.

hidden-city.rules: While you control it, your Illuminati gets +2 Power and +2 Global Power. Any Disaster may target it: it defends as a non-Huge, non-Coastal Place of Power 10 and can never be Devastated. If destroyed, anyone may play another.
hidden-city.flavor: Not on any map. Not visible from orbit. The post still arrives on Tuesdays.

hitler-s-brain.rules: Each time you destroy a Group, choose: draw 1 extra Plot, or turn all your exposed Plots face down again. While you hold this Resource, you cannot take control of Peaceful Groups.
hitler-s-brain.flavor: Specimen jar, sealed and labelled DO NOT FEED. Still drafting speeches nobody asked for.

immortality-serum.rules: Link to a Personality you control, or seize one as it is played (even from a rival's hand) without rolling. It can never be killed, even with its Place, and gets +5 against normal Attacks to Destroy. Link survives capture.
immortality-serum.flavor: Batch 1 of 1. Side effects include eternal life, mild nausea and endless re-election campaigns.

loch-ness-monster.rules: Nessie has its own action. Spend it to cancel an action by a Coastal Place, to add +4 to an Attack to Destroy a Coastal Place, or to add +4 to a Disaster against one.
loch-ness-monster.flavor: Shy, ancient and fiercely litigious. Clear photographs are answered by her solicitors.

mercenaries.rules: Once per turn, the Mercenaries may spend their own action to add +4 to an Attack to Destroy or +1 to an Attack to Control.
mercenaries.flavor: Hired muscle, sold by the hour. No cheques, no refunds, no loyalty clause.

midas-mill.rules: Choose one. Unlinked: your Illuminati gets +2 Power and +2 Global Power. Or link the Mill to any Coastal Group: its Global Power becomes equal to its Power.
midas-mill.flavor: Grinds salt, gold and stock options. Off switch not located; shareholders forbid further searching.

necronomicon.rules: Link to a Magic or Violent Group: its Power is doubled. If it ever rolls 11 or 12, it is destroyed and this card stays, unlinked. The loss counts toward your victory only for a Servants of Cthulhu player.
necronomicon.flavor: Bound in something that was probably leather. Margin notes stop abruptly mid-sentence.

orbital-mind-control-lasers.rules: Any time except in a Privileged attack, spend the Lasers' action to add, remove or reverse one alignment of a Group in play. It lasts until the current player's turn ends.
orbital-mind-control-lasers.flavor: Coverage: the whole planet. Beam setting: gentle persuasion. Side effect: sudden enthusiasm for new policies.

perpetual-motion-machine.rules: Link to a Group. That Group receives 1 extra Action token at the start of every turn.
perpetual-motion-machine.flavor: Violates three laws of physics, two patents and one sternly worded university letter.

principia-discordia.rules: Count the Weird Groups you control, itself included: each Weird Group in your Power Structure adds that number to its Resistance. Five Weird Groups means +5 each.
principia-discordia.flavor: Holy text, first edition, written by accident. Every copy is misquoted, as intended.

rogue-boomer.rules: You get +5 on your Attacks to Control a Nation. Or, once, add +10 to your own attempt to destroy a Place, or to any Disaster; then discard it.
rogue-boomer.flavor: Missile submarine, crew of 140, owner of record unclear. Currently taking offers.

shroud-of-turin.rules: Each time you draw from your Plot or Group deck, first peek at its top card if you like. Reject it and take the bottom card, unseen, instead.
shroud-of-turin.flavor: Linen, provenance hotly disputed. The gift shop stocks it in three sizes.

soulburner.rules: If a rival captures a Group of yours: take 1 Plot from their deck, or reveal their hidden Plots. If a rival destroys one: take 2 Plots from their deck, or reveal their hidden Plots and choose one they discard.
soulburner.flavor: Engine runs on grievance. Output: an enemy's plans, served warm.

spear-of-longinus.rules: As often as you like, with no action: +1 to any player's Attack to Destroy or any Disaster, once per attack. An attack it helps counts as Magic, so defences against Magic may apply.
spear-of-longinus.flavor: Legend says its holder rules the world. Its current holder rules a regional storage unit.

suicide-squad.rules: Any time except in a Privileged attack, target a rival's Resource and roll one die. 1: the target is destroyed; the Squad survives. 2-5: both are destroyed. 6: only the Squad is. Destroyed cards are discarded.
suicide-squad.flavor: Personnel file: enthusiasm high, life-insurance premiums higher, return rate negligible.

the-bronze-head.rules: When a Group card you played from your hand fails its takeover, return it to your hand instead of discarding it.
the-bronze-head.flavor: Oracle, cast bronze. Answers every question truthfully, cryptically and, regrettably, in rhyme.

the-frog-god.rules: You may interfere on either side of a Privileged attack; other players still can't without special cards. It costs the Frog God's action, and each of your interfering Groups spends its action too.
the-frog-god.flavor: Idol, jade, one careful owner. Croaks in an ancient tongue, mostly about flies.

the-holy-grail.rules: Secretly note one Place under this card; it can't be changed. If an attack would destroy or Devastate that Place, reveal the note: the attack fails, and the Grail keeps guarding it. If that Place is captured, discard the Grail.
the-holy-grail.flavor: Sought for centuries. Found behind the breakfast cereal.

the-library-at-alexandria.rules: You get +5 on your attempts to take control of a Computer, Science or Magic Group.
the-library-at-alexandria.flavor: Never burned after all. Simply relocated, with a much stricter late-return policy.

warehouse-23.rules: When played, you may fetch an Artifact or Gadget from hand or deck: free automatic takeover. Resources may hide face down beneath it, unusable, unseen by rivals. Expose any time, permanently, to use at once. Hidden cards share its fate.
warehouse-23.flavor: Aisle 40, next to the ark, behind the thing we agreed never to open again.

weather-satellite.rules: It has 2 Action tokens but uses only 1 per attack. Spend one to give a Tornado, Hurricane or Rain of Frogs +10 or -4, or any other Attack to Destroy (Disasters included) on a non-Space Place +4 or -2.
weather-satellite.flavor: Forecasts accurate to the minute, since the forecaster also makes the weather.

xanadu.rules: Duplicates of your Groups add no bonus when played in attacks to control or destroy your Groups.
xanadu.flavor: Pleasure dome, sacred river, strict policy: no visitors, no photos, no copycats.

the-great-pyramid.rules: Each rival shows you the first Plot they draw each turn; no notes allowed. Tornadoes and Hurricanes cannot affect the Great Pyramid.
the-great-pyramid.flavor: Forty centuries on the job and still the best-kept filing system on Earth. Tours hourly, no flash.

pyramid-marketing-schemes.rules: This Group gets +1 Power and +2 Resistance for each Fanatic Group in your Power Structure.
pyramid-marketing-schemes.flavor: Recruit three friends and become a diamond director. Recruit none and become a cautionary tale.

trading-card-games.rules: Any time during your turn, you may discard this Group and put another Group from your hand in exactly its place in your Power Structure, with no roll.
trading-card-games.flavor: Collect them all, trade them all, then argue about the rules for a decade. Welcome to the club.
